title: Mary Queen of Scots to John Hamilton, Archbishop of St Andrews, Bolton, 18 January 1569, BL Add MS 33531 ff. 73-74 (DECODE R8347)

documents.route: Mary Queen of Scots (Bolton Castle) to John Hamilton, Archbishop of St Andrews (Scotland)

plaintext.source: contemporary decipherment of the whole cipher body on ff. 74r-74v, bound after the letter

transcription.source: decipherment on ff. 74r-v transcribed line by line from the DECODE images (hamilton1569/reading.md); cipher not transcribed
transcription.notes: Full-resolution scans, 6800 x 9400 px; the date day on f. 73v partly illegible.

system.summary: Letter substitution with invented signs for Scots, a th/y (thorn) sign, word signs for 'and' and 'to', and a few code signs for persons and states (Elizabeth, France, Spain), clear salutation and close.
system.notes: Key as reconstructed by Tomokiyo (DECODE DOC_ file on R8347), checked on the first cipher line.

prior_solution.where: contemporary decipherment on ff. 74r-v; calendared in Bain, Calendar of Scottish Papers ii (1900) no. 966 (second of that number); key reconstructed by Tomokiyo (cryptiana mary.htm) and filed on DECODE R8347 (18 Sept 2024)

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie to the model, set up Claude Code with Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Bain, Calendar of Scottish Papers ii, grepped for '33,531': fol. 73 = no. 966, Mary to the Archbishop of St Andrews, Bolton, 18 Jan 1568/9, '2 pp. Chiefly in cipher. (2) Decipher of same.'
Fetched the 4 DECODE images and the DOC_ key image with the shared cookie (decrypt-custom/filesrv; decrypt-web/filesrv 404s).
Viewed all four pages: f. 73r-v cipher letter signed 'Marie R', dated Bowtoun Januar 1568 (Old Style); ff. 74r-v the contemporary decipherment.
Cryptiana mary.htm: 'Mary-Hamilton Cipher (1569)', f.73r-74v, key reconstructed; same cipher in Cotton Caligula B IX f. 315b.
Decoded the first cipher line of f. 73r with Tomokiyo's key: 'it ... bein proposit', matching the decipherment's first line.
Transcribed the decipherment (ff. 74r-v, 53 lines) and the clear opening and close from strip crops of the full-resolution scans; listed the code signs the decipherer left unresolved.

outcome.method_basis: The contemporary decipherment bound as ff. 74r-v (calendared in Bain ii no. 966) was transcribed; Tomokiyo's key, filed on DECODE R8347, checked only the first cipher line.
outcome.notes: Read at the time (decipherment bound as f. 74), calendared by Bain in abstract, key by Tomokiyo. Recipient and sender identified; DECODE's Jan 1568 is Old Style for 18 Jan 1569. Full transcription of the decipherment in reading.md. Code signs Mn, X, n, k, m and others left as in the decipherment. Catalogue entry 84 removed.
